description: This file contains utility functions for creating different types of map layers (WMS, XYZ, WFS) using OpenLayers, including configuration handling and layer creation logic.

methods.name: createWmsLayer
methods.description: Creates a WMS layer using provided configuration.

methods.name: createXyzLayer
methods.description: Creates an XYZ tile layer based on configuration.

methods.name: createWfsLayer
methods.description: Creates a WFS vector layer with optional styling, fetching features based on extent and configuration.

methods.name: createLayer
methods.description: Creates a map layer (WMS, WFS, or XYZ) based on the provided layer configuration.
